behavior.durable_failure: The rebuild coordinator persists a fixed operation label and bounded exception class instead of raw builder or database diagnostics.
behavior.caller_failure: The original exception is still re-raised to the caller after failure status is recorded.
behavior.transaction: Failed projection work rolls back before the separate failed-status update is committed; partial activation remains prevented.

coverage: failure persistence omits a synthetic diagnostic marker
failed status is committed after projection rollback
original exception still propagates to the caller

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked connection and projection builders

limitations: No live PostgreSQL, graph builder source, RDF store, or IRI provider was used.
This does not establish populated projection parity or MAN-CAP-021 acceptance.
